summary: Milestone/Graffiti arcade racing series that began as a DOS Ridge Racer-style racer, shifted through rally and off-road entries, and returned as a 2026 anime-styled reboot.

entries.title: Screamer

emulation.notes: Use the official Windows GOG package for convenience; DOSBox can run original DOS media.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: DOS SVGA/accelerated-era output with modern scaling

primary.why: The original Screamer is an MS-DOS game, with official GOG emulated releases later made for Windows and Mac OS X. The Windows GOG route preserves the DOS game while giving the most convenient modern PC play path.
primary.how_to_play: Play the GOG Windows release, or run the original MS-DOS version in DOSBox if using original media.

entries.remaster_caveats: No modern remaster is sourced; GOG is an emulated reissue.

entries.title: Screamer 2

emulation.notes: Use GOG for modern convenience; original DOS media can be run through DOSBox.

primary.why: Screamer 2 was released for MS-DOS and later received official GOG emulated releases for Windows and Mac OS X. The Windows GOG version is the most convenient modern route for the original game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the GOG Windows release; use DOSBox for original MS-DOS media.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster is sourced; GOG is an emulated reissue.

entries.title: Screamer Rally

emulation.notes: Prefer the 3dfx renderer path for the sourced texture filtering and higher-resolution support.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: DOS 3dfx Voodoo output with emulator scaling

primary.why: Screamer Rally is sourced as an MS-DOS release that made use of 3dfx Voodoo hardware for higher resolution and texture filtering, so the DOS/3dfx route is the complete and highest-fidelity path.
primary.how_to_play: Run the DOS release with DOSBox staging or a 3dfx-capable wrapper/configuration when available.

entries.remaster_caveats: No remaster or official modern reissue is sourced.

emulation.notes: Use modern Windows compatibility tools or wrappers if renderer issues appear.

primary.why: Screamer 4x4 is a Windows-only off-road entry with hardware-acceleration renderer choices including Glide, Direct3D, and OpenGL, making the PC release the complete route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release on a compatibility setup, choosing the renderer that works best on the target system.

entries.title: Screamer

emulation.notes: No emulation needed for the recommended route.

primary.why: The 2026 Screamer reboot released for PlayStation 5, Windows, and Xbox Series X/S using Unreal Engine 5. Windows has the highest scalable fidelity ceiling, while the console releases do not have sourced exclusive content.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release on a modern PC at high settings; use PS5 or Xbox Series X/S only for console preference.

entries.remaster_caveats: This is a reboot/remake-inspired new game, not the same entry as the 1995 DOS original.
